text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instruction in relation to a revised development application for a site that contains two heritage resources at 187 King Street East and 65 George Street and a related ongoing development appeal at the Ontario Land Tribunal ("OLT"). An Ontario Land Tribunal Case Management Conference has been scheduled for November 3, 2021.

The Toronto Preservation Board recommends that: 1. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 19, 2021) from the City Solicitor, as amended by the Board in Closed Session. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the instructions in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 19, 2021) from the City Solicitor, if adopted by City Council, with the balance of the Confidential Attachment 1 to remain confidential as it contains advice which is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
